Appearance.description: Appearance observed at a particular placement; equal block states may have different models.

components.description: Empty for a primal aspect; otherwise the two components used by the game, including repeats.

discovered.description: Observed player knowledge; null when its client cache has not arrived.

frames.description: Empty means a still image; otherwise every frame specifies its crop and tick duration.

visual.description: Still preview plus a reviewed inventory program; never a recipe GUI.

Block.description: Actual block state observed in an isolated construction preview, including unmodified tile NBT.

Build.description: A whole construction preview, not a claim that every runtime machine condition passes.

completion.description: Present only for the pinned Botania enchanter's StructureLib display provider.

facing.description: GT uses south; the pinned compatibility wrapper uses ExtendedFacing.DEFAULT (north). Historical GT builds omit this field.

origin.description: Dummy-world coordinate of local [0, 0, 0]; never a player-world position.

rendered.description: False when appearance capture was not requested (the data profile).

result.description: The survival constructor's final result; creative construction has no return code.

size.description: Coordinates are east, down, north, independent of the native construction orientation.

BuildCompletion.description: A native display provider can intentionally supply geometry before gameplay completion.

reference.description: Independently transported native reference domain, not consuming recipes.

index.description: Index into the declaring piece's rules or the build's block palette.

bindings.description: One choice index (or an empty optional slot) per recipe input, per sample. Native correlated processes use tuples. Excluded from recipe identity with samples.

samples.description: One native result per input choice, in matching order; excluded from recipe identity.

amount.description: Signed-64-bit count/millibuckets. Zero requires a native fluid policy; Forestry has native signed values.

Circuit.description: A circuit family or component family defined by the game's diagram provider. Adjacent steps describe progression, not a fabricated crafting recipe.

Clue.description: A declared TC item trigger, independent of whether NEI lists a concrete example.

matches.description: Sorted unique IDs of observed catalog items accepted by the native matcher. Empty preserves the condition without inventing an obtainable item.

meta.description: Raw metadata. 32767 is TC's wildcard, not a concrete item subtype.

ore.description: The first native ore group, checked before item/meta/NBT matching.

amount.description: Relative component count from the material definition, not a recipe quantity.

oneOf.description: One native draw determines whether a unit is consumed.
IC2 blast: amount is the stock gate; its process consumes a unit at each stage.
Vat: presence of one item is sufficient; remove min(amount, available) at start.
An ordered native requirement; the process allocates actual machine slots.
Optional SAG ball inventory; consumed on loading active ball state, not per task.
Splice tools: conditional damageItem(1, fakePlayer) at completion, not fixed durability.
Consume the entire offered stack. `amount` is the minimum/example count.
Internal fluid stock gate; the paired native process defines when and how it drains. Some machines empty it at start; others repeatedly allow partial drains during work.
One item on each distinct pedestal. With Runic, amount is the sample multiplicity; the process defines the actual input-dependent count.
Installed GT container tool: native units, conditional energy use and wear. Sample fields describe only the captured candidate, not arbitrary player NBT.
Workbench calls the pinned callback on the actual offered stack after consuming one. The result depends on wear/RNG or cosmetic NBT, never a fixed sample return.

CraftingSelector.description: Ordered requirements. None grid means native greedy shapeless matching in offered row-major cell order; a grid permits translations and its mirror flag.

DefinitionKind.description: A StructureLib definition, not a claim that one assembled machine passes its world checks.

oneOf.description: Base result with the LAST tagged offered crafting cell's entire compound. Samples are [untagged base, then each input choice projection in slot order].
Output of the process's ordered integration rule and a correlated input tuple.
Fresh broken spawner: base registry, meta=0, count=1, only mobType string. The string is native getMobTypeFromStack(input0), not the full entity NBT.

Fresh floating special flower, meta=0/count=1, with only a string `type`. Base supplies only the registry from a renderable example; all its tags are discarded. Missing `type` becomes an empty string; non-string values are outside the paired process's explicit input domain, never silently coerced.
Observed native getString coercion, including non-string NBT examples.
Copy the offered map and tags, set count=1 and map_is_scaling byte=1. This is the result before ItemMap.onCreated allocates the final world ID.
Native Runic augmentation: copy the input and increment RS.HARDEN using Minecraft getByte coercion followed by signed-byte wrapping.
Copy the central input according to the paired native infusion effect.

Forestry 4.10.17 native member analysis. A previously analyzed stack is copied unchanged; otherwise serialize the individual into a fresh compound after analyze(). Item, metadata and the entire offered count are retained. Samples are canonical native serialization fixed points, so their only tag difference is IsAnalyzed.
Copy the input item, metadata, count and tags. Replace root tags, then cap numeric tags using Minecraft getInteger semantics (missing/non-numeric = 0).
Salis 1.1.33 copies wand state, patches component/charge tags, then resets metadata to max(native crafting Vis cost, 0). Plain Patch retains metadata.
TC4Tweaks inheritance: output scalars win, compounds merge and equal-type lists append. An untagged base instead inherits input metadata/count and the entire input compound.

keys.description: None copies all root keys. A nonempty list filters only the root merge.

tools.description: Both input and base must be armor or have at least one native tool class.

oneOf.description: Automagy PreserveFilterRecipe. Preserve the base item/count/tags; replace ContainedItems and FilterOptions using native inventory serialization. A later filter supplies metadata; otherwise the base metadata is retained.

configurations.description: One native InventoryWithFilterOptions.writeCustomNBT result per config choice, in the same order. Numeric item lookup happens in the pinned game registry; these observations are not a promise to replay arbitrary NBT.

oneOf.description: Native list append (e.g. Thaumic Machina wand augmentations): Copy the input item, metadata, count and tags. Append `value` to the list at `path`. Missing paths and Minecraft's empty end-list are created; an existing scalar is rejected because it cannot preserve native data.
Ordinary fixed/tag output is described by the existing output/change contract.

terms.description: Precomputed search text includes registry, display name, tooltip, ore tags and pinyin.

knowledge.description: Digests of knowledge states used by adapters; no player names or world locations.

probes.description: Construction parameters, ordered by count then channel name/value pairs.

resources.description: Selected resource packs, in the game's priority order.

vertices.description: Original winding; triangles repeat their third vertex in the fourth position.

acidity.description: Native Botany soil symbols, distinct from Forestry air humidity.

type.description: Native IFlowerType identifier; colors remain separate chromosome values.

registry.description: The actual global Forge fluid key, which need not contain a namespace.

GendustryOutputPolicy.description: A displayed NEI result is one observation of the machine callback. These variants retain the other outcomes of the same input tuple and RNG draw.

oneOf.description: A non-drone bee may die before imprinting; natural/artificial rates come from Config and the subsequent labware draw still takes place.
World-restricted mutations can leave no candidate. A selected natural bee may degrade; an artificial bee may die and become waste.

Gene.description: A populated chromosome of a registered template, not a player's individual genome.

value.description: An API-provided scalar or vector. Providers with executable behavior have no invented value.

Grid.description: Native crafting arrangement, independent of presentation.

cells.description: Row-major item input slot references, with explicit empty cells.

positions.description: Physical 3x3 inventory cell for each logical input, not GUI coordinates.

fluidAlternatives.description: Null falls back to the representative; nonnull empty does not.

inputChances.description: Captured raw values, not reconstructed getter results. Null/empty/short differ.

itemInputs.description: Array position is the native slot, including null holes.

sampler.description: The default helper's sampler, not a promise that every machine uses it.

amount.description: Exact signed native int; zero and invalid negative evidence stay distinct.

rotation.description: Native Z, Y, X radians, applied with ModelRenderer's float degree conversion.

vertices.description: Position XYZ, packed-normal XYZ and UV; two ordered triangles per native quad.

armor.description: Actual ItemArmor classification; durability alone does not identify armor or tools.

aspects.description: Thaumcraft's returned object tags; null means it provided no value, not zero aspects.

durability.description: Raw ItemStack.getMaxDamage() result; negative values retain mod-specific meaning.

name.description: Reference to a localized, Minecraft-formatted string.

order.description: NEI order; null denotes an item discovered only through a recipe.

tags.description: Exact OreDictionary membership reported by the game.

ores.description: Actual OreDictionary.getOreIDs order, before sorting for catalog Item.tags.

tagStrings.description: Native NBTBase.toString observations; compound order is not reconstructed from JSON.

Lineage.description: Mutation adjacency, so one species page never decodes the entire breeding graph.

MagicRecipe.description: Registered recipe costs before equipment discounts and observed research prerequisites.

aspects.description: Vis for arcane crafting; essentia for crucible and infusion recipes. With Process::Runic these are sample costs, validated against sample charge.

central.description: Item input slot containing the central infusion ingredient.

creative.description: The configured creative-mode waiver bypasses Vis checks/consumption. An empty arcane cost list is usable only with this waiver, not free in survival.

instability.description: Base infusion instability, independent of the player's altar and stabilizers.

payment.description: Optional Salis self-payment. Ordinary arcane output samples assume a separate wand in the workbench's supply slot; this mode requires it empty.

locale.description: Actual game capture language, shared by all display text and search projections.

oneOf.description: Display anchor only; the ordered shared pool session owns admission.
EntitySingularity passes the offered stack first to itemMatches(false).
Native oven admission partitioned by the offered stack's Genome tags. The display anchor may belong to another partition; it is not a witness.
Native literal metadata and tag presence; compound values at required keys trigger the pinned matcher's recursive failure.
Example of a multi-slot integration rule, not an independent item predicate.
Native Forestry shared-stock requirement; the linked machine process owns matching.
Require absent or empty root NBT. `meta: true` ignores metadata.
BuildCraft StackHelper: either-side wildcard skips metadata and NBT; otherwise native subtype and typed-tag comparison. See docs/buildcraft.md.
Native ItemSoulVessel extraction, including null and non-string root ids. Canonical display samples do not restrict the admitted input domain.
AE2 precise item matching for an ordinary NBT anchor: literal metadata, null/empty root equivalence, numeric floats, recursive typed tags. See docs/inscriber.md.

Pinned TC untagged infusion component. Match template item/meta, or an offered stack whose FIRST native ore group is in ores. Unlike Ore, mere membership in a later group is insufficient. Extra offered NBT is allowed.
A native Forestry member of this registry and root, with the given analysis state. Examples use canonical native serialization; other valid genomes are not excluded.
Ignore selected parts of an ingredient's identity. For fluids, the only wildcard is `meta: false, nbt: true`; the fluid registry is always fixed.

Same registry, any metadata, with the named root tag absent or a string. Other tags are unrestricted. This explicitly excludes native non-string coercion paths that cannot be reconstructed from canonical NBT.

Literal raw metadata independent of the concrete display item. Registry and, unless nbt is true, NBT still come from that item. Absent root keys are rejected even when their stored value is false or zero.

value.description: Nonnegative raw metadata, or Railcraft's native -1 sentinel.

oneOf.description: Finite physical-metadata partition, or its complement. Shared values keep large native smelting domains compact without changing item identity.
Pinned logical getter; Item.meta remains the physical stack metadata.
Compare only the named root tags with the choice; other tags are allowed. Presence checks ignore the tag's type and value, including false/zero.

Match exact registry/metadata and remaining NBT after removing only these root keys from the offered stack. Normalize an empty offered compound to null, then compare it to the unmodified choice's NBT. All other tags matter.

Match the base predicate, except any listed earlier predicate. Each exclusion has its own item anchor; it is not an accepted alternative. Exactly one level is permitted; members and nested exclusions are rejected.

color.description: ARGB color reported by the registry.

formula.description: The source's formula verbatim; not parsed or guessed from an item tooltip.

content.description: Material units in one item; null when the source does not define a conversion.

key.description: Registry form, e.g. plate, wireGt01, molten. It is not inferred from a name.

form.description: Actual item form, e.g. queen, drone, sapling, pollen.

Model.description: Native tessellated faces. Texture coordinates refer to one source sprite, not its packed atlas.

hidden.description: Explicit native suppression (for example the second block of a double chest), never a failed capture.

chance.description: Unmodified base rate in 0..1; housing, mode, research and world conditions are not applied.

conditions.description: Localized descriptions from the provider, not executable eligibility rules.

genes.description: The mutation's actual result template can differ from the species' registered default.

handler.description: Actual implementation class; conditions remain descriptive, not executable rules.

id.description: Content identity: Forestry exposes no mutation registry key.

occurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence among identical registrations, retaining independent attempts.

parents.description: An unordered pair, canonically sorted. Self-crosses retain two equal entries.

oneOf.description: IC2 2.2.828: copy, attemptDamageItem(1, IC2.random), null on break.
Botania 1.12.28: deserialize cosmeticItem from the offered bauble NBT, or null.
Botania 1.12.28: copy the offered talisman, debit up to 64 blocks and reset active metadata.
Thaumic Bases 1.8.13: damage + 1, fresh tagless stack; absent when exhausted.
Railcraft 9.16.33: native random wear and enchantment-dependent breakage.
A concrete canonical item fact, shared by query bindings and original lookups. Wildcard templates still require the explicit Item variant.
GTRecipe's cost calculation ignores this entry. Machine lookup/validation is separate.
Industrial Rock Breaker checks fluid identity even when its amount is zero.
Vat containsFluid requires the exact fluid and NBT; a zero-volume object is sufficient.
Incubator still requires the exact fluid/NBT object, with a native zero drain cost.

Note.description: Native explanatory text, bound to a stable field key and its reader source. Display text is not part of a recipe's semantic identity.

members.description: Number of original registration-list positions, including duplicates.

name.description: Exact native ore dictionary name, not a translated item label.

order.description: Native Java string ordering of all registered non-null names.

display.description: A verified concrete NEI example; null when none is known safe to display.

amount.description: Signed native stackSize. Registry metadata, not a consumption quantity.

meta.description: Raw stored metadata; 32767 remains a wildcard template, never a display stack.

change.description: With a change, id/amount are the first input choice's example, not a fixed result.

Payment.description: The consumed input pays the arcane cost using its OLD components and the player's equipment discount. After payment, the new wand retains the remaining charge up to capacity, or zeros these tags. No fixed paid-output sample is implied.

charges.description: Primal aspect id -> root NBT charge key. Charge/capacity are hundredths of Vis.

size.description: Local A/B/C coordinates: right, down, depth. Pieces have no inferred assembly transform.

oneOf.description: Pinned 5.09.51.482 stores ore metadata in the TileEntity, then native impact marks it natural.
Resolved using the source-bound current network mode, without invoking the supplier.

Process.description: Native shared process, not independent probabilities on individual outputs. See docs/harmony.md for state, energy, rounding and correlated yield rules.

terminals.description: Registered instances of the native terminal/booster classes.

states.description: One actual native result witness per distinct rule-relevant result state. Index-aligned with output.change.samples, never a Cartesian tuple table.

transfers.description: Native simulated discharge for each concrete offered count-one specimen.

oneOf.description: Vanilla LAST-tagged-input result, with independent native projections.

slots.description: Native inventory slots 1..5. A null is required empty, not an unchecked cell.

nativeDefinitions.description: Sealed role-to-definition map copied from the native callback. This keeps material roles bound to concrete identities across compilation.

textureMetadata.description: Native item-to-block metadata normalization may change the displayed texture metadata.

earlier.description: Earlier original recipes in this action, after expansion to item/meta keys.

keys.description: Current action-list item/meta keys. Order is immaterial, multiplicity matters.

oneOf.description: One native weighted selection per draw, shared by all candidate outputs.

weights.description: Native registry order; zero-weight candidates cannot be selected.

oneOf.description: Native genome admission, stateful work and input-dependent NBT results.
Native shared stock/selection, conditional output and powered work steps.
Retained native recipe selection, periodic preflight and ordered NBT transformation.
IC2 heat/air checkpoints, persistent progress and native output-space behavior.

containers.description: Per input slot and choice: container left in that input slot when consuming a single item. Stacks >1 with a container are not consumed. Air choice returns still describe the separate air-output slot.

oneOf.description: Output prototype receives ExtraUtilities 1.2.12's conditional world-clock tags at completion, not at export time. See docs/casting.md.
BuildCraft's cached refinery selection, retry timer and sequential tank drain.
Selected BuildCraft assembly plan; ordered greedy allocation and signed RF budget.

repair.description: Complete intersection of item types admitted by both occupied cells. The Item.isRepairable branch is audited by the native producer. Maximum is the signed native no-argument field, never a guessed tool quantity.

oneOf.description: Railcraft shared ordered crafting registry and native reserve/power gates.
Extra Utilities QED ordered crafting registry. A completed craft drains the native default Ender Flux buffer and one item from every occupied cell.
Registered GalaxySpace crafting is conditional on native repair priority. Timing remains dependent on the external power tier.

Botania's ordinary floating-flower crafting within a 2x2 or 3x3 grid. Special inputs bind in increasing physical cell order. Only a missing or string `type` on the last special input is in the admitted domain.

aspects.description: Native aspect tag -> stable aspect identity for interpreting essence NBT.

roles.description: Native item roles, not a complete enumeration of admissible NBT states.

replacementsActive.description: Loaded native class contains the GTNH replacement Mixin state/helper.

oneOf.description: Native two-slot Soul Binder selection, XP debit and last-vessel completion.
Native SAG task and grinding-ball lifecycle; see docs/grinding.md.
Registered EnderIO alloy matching and separate consumption traversals.
Six ingredients plus axe/shears slots; native conditional tool wear at completion.
EnderIO precomputed fluid pair and ordered item consumption; see docs/vat.md.
EnderIO manual enchanter. The offered material count determines the level; cost is signed native XP levels, not energy. See docs/enchanter.md.
AE2 registered recipe, after the name-press guard and earlier registry rows. top absent has a native empty-slot predicate; see docs/inscriber.md.

Vanilla map extension. Input eligibility depends on world MapData (scale < 4). The output is a pre-onCreated sample; the world allocates the final map ID. Missing data may be initialized server-side. See docs/maps.md.

Dynamic TC runic augmentation. Charge, component multiplicity and magic costs are an observed sample. Actual costs use the offered IRunicArmor's native final charge, including nested upgrades; see docs/runic.md.

charge.description: Observed final charge of the supplied center, never a constant for its whole item class.

chance.description: Round-trip decimal representation of the native binary64 base chance.
Bee base rate per production cycle. Tree product lists supply no probability: null.

Quantity.description: Correlated amounts, evaluated without arbitrary sampling.

oneOf.description: Native in-world yield depends on power, settings and output acceptance.
No per-opening fixed amount: shared draws, retry state and split-stack budget.
Prototype count scaled by the complete altar input stack at completion.
Stack size for one selection in a shared HarvestCraft draw process.
Native signed output parameter; the shared Squeezer process determines actual completion.
Both fixed Soul Binder outputs share the last-vessel completion gate.
SAG shared task draw and correlated completion passes. See docs/grinding.md.
One shared Java nextFloat draw, output when threshold >= draw. See docs/alloy.md.
All outputs share the recipe's native process outcome and yield.

Ratio.description: An exact amount of base material, independent of item counts or fluid volume.

duration.description: Raw native tick value, when defined. Negative values are upstream anomalies, not elapsed time; preserve them and do not infer an effective execution duration.

energy.description: Signed EU/t; negative values denote generation.

gtNative.description: GT native arrays and unresolved execution policy, separate from display projections.

order.description: Native category-local position; branches can tie. Sort tied records by id.

properties.description: Namespaced properties with an explicit value type and unit.

RecipeIndex.description: Compact recipe metadata for filtering and counts without decoding full ingredient payloads.

copies.description: Central input is copied once, a pedestal input twice, before comparison.

cycleTagStrings.description: craftingStart copies each component once before the later pedestal comparison.

defaultOres.description: Ore groups whose actual member list accepts the original template.

Research.description: Research prerequisites and observed knowledge, not a claim that the player can currently unlock it.

id.description: Null preserves an unregistered recipe knowledge key. Research-tree links require a definition except for Thaumcraft's @ knowledge flags.

conflicts.description: Object identities encoded as indices, independently of the public numeric id.

placements.description: Advisory getBlocksToPlace results, never an exhaustive legality predicate or bill of materials. Null means the provider does not enumerate placement stacks.

Shape.description: Bounded geometry records keep large definitions out of a single source row or HTTP response.

exclude.description: Complement for spawner blacklist; includes null in names.

names.description: Sorted unique native mob strings, with explicit null extraction result.

vessel.description: Empty native vessel item reference; metadata does not constrain input.

fruitCompatible.description: Whether the tree species supports its default template's fruit family.

jubilance.description: Native bee specialty-condition description; not a live housing eligibility result.

nocturnal.description: Natural bee or butterfly activity; distinct from nocturnal tolerance chromosomes.

source.description: The root UID is the handler; the species allele UID is the key.

temperature.description: Native climate symbols from Forestry, not guessed biome or numeric ranges.

chance.description: Raw IEEE-754 float bits. NaN must not turn into a guaranteed remnant.

SqueezerSelector.description: Stable positions in one content-addressed native registry snapshot.

definitionKind.description: Older structure records omit this field and use enumerable StructureLib definitions. Construction providers supply actual builds, not invented definition pieces.

probe.description: First requested parameter set, used for definition placement hints.

problem.description: An explicit missing definition is allowed only in a selection snapshot.

Template.description: A registered predicate, including wildcard metadata, has no display name/icon.

voltage.description: Nominal voltage in EU per packet.

handleModifier.description: Exact native IEEE754 float bits, including negative native modifiers.

image.description: A standalone atlas image when this topic has no item/fluid icon.

sizes.description: Signed Java-int observations from Mobs Info, never executable consumption amounts.

oneOf.description: An observed native viewer fault. This is neither an empty cell nor a non-match.

Variant.description: Exactly one outcome for a requested construction parameter set.

at.description: Finite float32 decimal strings in local east/down/north block coordinates. Strings preserve the game's decimal representation across Java, Rust and JavaScript identities.

color.description: Native per-vertex tint and shading, in unsigned RRGGBBAA byte order.

uv.description: Finite float32 decimal strings in the sprite's [0,1] range, top row at v=0.

oneOf.description: 65536 native float32 values, each encoded as eight raw IEEE hex digits.

levels.description: One lossless frame sheet for each actually uploaded native mip.

resolution.description: Native LWJGL Sys units per second, never assumed to be milliseconds.

description: Owns the schema exported to consumers; it is not a runtime payload itself.
